title: Don't Lose Focus: Activation Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections
abstract: arXiv:2605.06342v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Activation steering controls LLM behaviour towards target behaviour by intervening in internal representations, yet it often degrades reasoning and retrieval performance. We argue that a primary cause of this trade-off is attention rerouting: steering vectors alter query-key matching, shifting attention away from contextually important tokens toward less informative ones. To address this, we propose Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections (SKOP), a steering method that constrains harmful attention rerouting without eliminating steering efficacy. SKOP achieves this by preserving attention patterns on a small set of focus tokens the model relies on for reasoning and retrieval, while allowing redistribution among less critical tail tokens. Across multiple steering benchmarks, we show that SKOP achieves the best joint steering-utility trade-off, reducing utility degradation by 5-7x while retaining over 95% of vanilla steering efficacy. translated_title: 别失去焦点：基于键正交投影的激活引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导通过干预内部表示来控制大语言模型（LLM）的行为朝向目标行为，然而它常常会降低推理和检索性能。我们认为造成这种权衡的一个主要原因是注意力重路由：引导向量改变了查询-键匹配，使注意力从上下文重要的token转移到信息量较少的token上。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于键正交投影的引导方法——这是一种能够在保留引导效力的同时约束有害注意力重路由的引导方法。SKOP通过在模型依赖用于推理和检索的一小部分焦点token上保持注意力模式来实现这一点，同时允许在不太关键的尾部token之间重新分配注意力。在多个引导基准测试中，我们证明了SKOP实现了最佳的联合引导-效用权衡，将效用损失降低了5-7倍，同时保留了超过95%的原始引导效力。
tldr: 提出SKOP方法，通过键正交投影约束有害的注意力重路由，在保留超过95%引导效力的同时将效用损失降低5-7倍。
en_tdlr: SKOP constrains harmful attention rerouting via key-orthogonal projections, reducing utility degradation by 5-7x while retaining over 95% of steering efficacy.
